title: Rogers-Ramanujan and Schur partition identities in Lean

currentState.focus: Building GF coefficient infrastructure toward axiom elimination

schurModGF, rr1ModGF: specialized GFs for partition identities

distinctPartGF_coeff_empty: base case of coefficient theorem (proved)

insights: All 3 axioms encode deep partition identities (RR1, RR2, Schur)
